title: Presbyterian Church in America v. South Florida Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC found Presbytery had responded to the citation and all outstanding exceptions of substance. It found all responses satisfactory except the response concerning charges against a teaching elder. It approved previously unsubmitted 2009 executive-session minutes with a new exception of substance, required amended minutes to be submitted for review, and directed Presbytery to complete or plan overdue Session-record reviews and report to the 45th General Assembly.
first_summary: South Florida Presbytery complied with a General Assembly citation by submitting properly adopted responses to outstanding exceptions. The SJC accepted most responses but rejected one because it did not address BCO 32-2’s requirement to begin process when a charge is made. It also approved previously unsubmitted minutes with an exception concerning the divestiture of a teaching elder and directed Presbytery to complete overdue Session-record reviews.
summary: Reviewing South Florida Presbytery’s response to a General Assembly citation, the SJC found most responses satisfactory but rejected one because it did not address BCO 32-2’s requirement to proceed once a charge is made. It approved previously unsubmitted 2009 executive-session minutes with an exception because their treatment of a teaching elder appeared to violate BCO 46-8. Presbytery also had to submit amended minutes and complete, or formally plan, overdue Session-record reviews for report to the 45th General Assembly.
